products.title: Hound & Harbor Wild Alaskan Salmon & Sweet Potato Kibble
products.description: Veterinarian-formulated ultra-clean recipe featuring sustainably caught wild Alaskan salmon as the single animal protein source. Enriched with cold-pressed salmon oil for lustrous coat shine and prebiotic sweet potatoes for calm digestion. 100% grain-free, chicken-free, and corn-free.
products.shortDescription: Clean single-protein wild salmon recipe for radiant skin, coat, and sensitive stomachs.

products.title: Heritage Ranch Grass-Fed Beef & Ancient Quinoa Recipe
products.description: Human-grade USDA pasture-raised Angus beef simmered with ancient non-GMO grains including organic quinoa, sorghum, and chia seeds. Promotes sustained energy for working and athletic breeds without gastric inflammation.
products.shortDescription: Pasture-raised Texas beef combined with anti-inflammatory ancient grains.

products.title: Freeze-Dried Raw New Zealand Venison & Cranberry Dinner Patties
products.description: 95% free-range New Zealand venison, nutrient-dense organs, and crushed bone gently freeze-dried to lock in living digestive enzymes and peak bioavailability. Rehydrates in warm water or bone broth in under 3 minutes.
products.shortDescription: Peak primal raw venison nutrition with zero synthetic binders or preservatives.

products.title: Senior Vitality Gentle Alaskan Cod & Turmeric Golden Formula
products.description: Specifically crafted for mature dogs aged 7+. Features highly digestible wild Pacific cod, organic curcumin turmeric to combat chronic inflammation, and glucosamine for easing morning stiffness.
products.shortDescription: Gentle, anti-inflammatory wild cod recipe designed for aging hips and kidneys.

products.title: Single-Ingredient Grass-Fed Beef Liver Training Treats
products.description: Just one ingredient: 100% USDA inspected USA pasture-raised beef liver freeze-dried raw to retain 98% of natural micronutrients, iron, and aroma. Irresistible high-value reward for obedience training.
products.shortDescription: High-value freeze-dried single-ingredient training reward loved by all dogs.

products.title: Himalayan Organic Yak Milk Hard Chews (Pack of 3 XL)
products.description: Sun-cured Himalayan hard cheese handmade using traditional nepalese techniques with yak milk, lime juice, and salt. 100% digestible, zero rawhide danger, and hours of continuous gnawing enjoyment.
products.shortDescription: Long-lasting natural yak cheese chew; fully digestible rawhide alternative.

products.title: Crispy Wild Salmon Skin Rolls with Pure Marine Collagen
products.description: Hand-rolled Alaskan wild salmon skins, slow-dehydrated over 36 hours. Packed with natural omega-3 fatty acids and type 1 marine collagen to strengthen canine nails, ligaments, and skin elasticity.
products.shortDescription: Crunchy dehydrated salmon skin rolls loaded with restorative marine collagen.

products.title: VitalityPlus Glucosamine, Chondroitin & Green-Lipped Mussel Chews
products.description: Scientifically backed hip and joint soft chews packed with pure New Zealand green-lipped mussel, MSM, and glucosamine HCl. Enhances synovial joint fluid lubrication and mobility for active, working, and senior dogs.
products.shortDescription: Veterinary strength joint support chews for fluid movement and agility.

products.title: Pure Wild Alaskan Salmon & Krill Oil (Pumping Dispenser)
products.description: Cold-pressed unrefined salmon and antarctic krill oil delivering over 1,200mg EPA and DHA per pump. Stops chronic paw licking and dry skin dandruff while enhancing cognitive brain function.
products.shortDescription: Cold-pressed wild marine oil pump for deep coat shine and joint lubrication.

products.title: ZenPup Calming Hemp, Chamomile & L-Theanine Soft Bites
products.description: Veterinarian-formulated calming bites designed for separation anxiety, thunderstorm terror, fireworks, and veterinary visits. Uses full-spectrum broad organic hemp extract and calming amino acids with zero sedation hangover.
products.shortDescription: Natural anxiety relief soft chews for fireworks, travel, and thunderstorms.

products.title: Cascade All-Weather Biothane Tactical Dog Leash (Marketplace Artisan)
products.description: Handmade by Seattle artisan Marcus Vance of Timber & Trail. 100% waterproof, odor-proof, and flexible down to -20°F. Equipped with solid brass aviation-grade snap hardware that never corrodes in salt water or mud.
products.shortDescription: Handcrafted waterproof biothane mountain leash with solid brass aviation clip.

products.title: TrailMaster No-Pull Ergonomic Front-Clip Dog Harness
products.description: Engineered with dual leash attachment points (front chest ring for gentle steering without choking and back D-ring for relaxed trail walks). Lined with breathable air-mesh and 3M Scotchlite reflective piping.
products.shortDescription: Dual-clip ergonomic harness that gently redirects pulling without throat strain.

products.title: Heritage English Bridle Leather Collar with Personalized Brass Tag
products.description: Bench-crafted from 10-12 oz vegetable-tanned Wickett & Craig English bridle leather. Edges are hand-burnished with natural beeswax. Includes a custom-engraved solid brass nameplate riveted flush to the collar.
products.shortDescription: Artisan heirloom bridle leather collar with custom riveted solid brass tag.

products.title: CloudRest Orthopedic Memory Foam Ergonomic Dog Bed
products.description: Multi-density 4-inch medical-grade memory foam base that eliminates joint pressure points for aging canines or large athletic breeds. Features a machine-washable waterproof liner and removable stain-resistant microsuede exterior cover.
products.shortDescription: Dual-layer therapeutic memory foam cushion that soothes canine joints and hips.

products.title: Calming Sherpa Donut Cuddler Anti-Anxiety Nest Bed
products.description: Round rim doughnut bed with deep crevices and ultra-soft vegan faux-shag fur. Satisfies canine denning instincts, helping anxious dogs self-soothe and enter restorative deep REM sleep cycles.
products.shortDescription: Self-warming faux shag fur donut nest designed to relieve canine anxiety.

products.title: Elevated Outdoor Cooling Cot with Breathable Textilene Mesh
products.description: Raises your dog 8 inches off hot summer concrete, damp grass, or cold winter drafts. Features a rust-proof powder-coated steel chassis and puncture-resistant UV-shielded Textilene woven fabric.
products.shortDescription: Heavy-duty elevated cooling cot that promotes 360-degree airflow.

products.title: BrainQuest Multi-Level Interactive Canine Puzzle Feeder
products.description: Level 2 mental enrichment puzzle designed to curb boredom and slow down rapid eaters. Features sliding compartments, rotating discs, and scent vent holes crafted from food-grade BPA/PVC-free composite material.
products.shortDescription: Challenging mental enrichment puzzle that stimulates canine problem-solving.

products.title: Indestructible Natural Rubber Treat-Dispensing Grenade Chew
products.description: Molded from ultra-tough 100% natural vulcanized tree rubber designed to survive aggressive pit bull and mastiff power chewers. Fill with peanut butter, kibble, or Greek yogurt and freeze for hours of calm licking.
products.shortDescription: Heavy-duty puncture-proof treat puzzle toy for aggressive power chewers.

products.title: SnuffleMat Wool Fleece Foraging Feeding Mat
products.description: Simulates outdoor grass foraging in your living room. Over 300 hand-tied dense fleece ribbons hide dry kibble or training treats, stimulating your dog’s natural olfactory scent-tracking instincts and lowering heart rates.
products.shortDescription: Scent-foraging brain game mat that turns dinner into a 20-minute mental adventure.

products.title: [Certified Pre-Owned] Impact Heavy-Duty Stationary Dog Crate (40")
products.description: Hound & Harbor certified pre-owned aluminum dog crate. Inspected by our logistics hub: zero dents, tested slam-latch gate with dual security deadbolts, fully sanitized and steam-sterilized. Backed by our 30-day pre-owned guarantee.
products.shortDescription: Platform-certified indestructible aircraft-grade aluminum crate. 100% escape-proof.

products.title: [Certified Pre-Owned] Ruff Land Kennel Intermediate Gen II Crate
products.description: One-piece rotationally molded PE construction that absorbs vehicular crash impacts. Inspected, thoroughly power-steamed, and certified zero hairline cracks by Hound & Harbor technicians.
products.shortDescription: Indestructible rotomolded crash-tested travel kennel with reversible composite door.

products.title: AeroTravel Airline Approved Expandable Underseat Pet Carrier
products.description: Meets Delta, United, and American Airlines cabin sizing requirements. Expands on all 4 sides into a spacious micro-tent during layovers. Features claw-defense ballistic mesh and fleece pad insert.
products.shortDescription: 4-side expanding cabin underseat pet travel bag with locking zippers.

products.title: Folding Telescopic Lightweight Aluminum Dog Vehicle Ramp (62")
products.description: Engineered for senior canines or dogs recovering from orthopedic surgery. Features high-traction sandpaper grip surface, raised safety side rails, and rubberized vehicle bumpers that protect your SUV trunk paint.
products.shortDescription: Gentle incline vehicle access ramp supporting dogs up to 200 lbs.

products.title: Colloidal Oatmeal & Organic Aloe Soothing Dog Shampoo
products.description: Tear-free hypoallergenic bath wash pH-balanced specifically for canine epidermal sensitivity. Calms dry, itchy, or allergic skin with natural colloidal oatmeal and organic Moroccan argan oil.
products.shortDescription: Gentle pH-balanced soothing wash for sensitive or allergy-prone coats.

products.title: Organic Herbal Paw Wax & Snout Soothing Protective Balm
products.description: All-natural lick-safe formula made with organic yellow beeswax, organic shea butter, and calendula flower extract. Shields delicate paw pads from winter street salts, freezing ice snowballs, and scalding summer asphalt.
products.shortDescription: Lick-safe organic shield against hot asphalt, ice, and winter sidewalk chemicals.

products.title: Ultra-Quiet USB-C 2-Speed Diamond Bit Canine Nail Grinder
products.description: Operates under 40 decibels to eliminate dog fear and nail clipper panic. Equipped with an advanced diamond drum bit and dual LED focal lights that illuminate the quick for painless, safe manicures.
products.shortDescription: Whisper-quiet electric trimmer with safety guard and LED quick illumination.

products.title: Professional Dual-Sided Undercoat De-Shedding Rake
products.description: Stainless steel rounded teeth that effortlessly thin out loose undercoat fur without scratching sensitive canine skin. Reduces seasonal household hair shedding by up to 95% on double-coated breeds.
products.shortDescription: Dual-sided stainless steel undercoat rake that reduces shedding by 95%.
